No evidence of malicious activity was found. All operations align with standard AUR packaging practices: cloning from the declared upstream, building from source, and installing to `$pkgdir`. There are no suspicious downloads, obfuscated commands, unauthorized network requests, or system modifications outside the package scope. While the version determination relies on upstream tooling, this is expected for a development package and does not constitute a supply-chain compromise.
